scope: Separate single-base offline RAG semantic review after full genuine fresh-readback validation; no matched comparison, live latency or human-quality claim.

input_gate.source: Verified m6_rag_delivery final result and its private restored condition-output/ plus exact inputs/plan.json and execution-contract-bf16-v2.json
reject: partial snapshots as final condition inputs

files.reviewer/samples.json: Only normalized completed outputs, unchanged: opaque sample ID, case ID, source-pool ID, question, exact answer, answer SHA-256, null human ratings/reviewer fields.
files.reviewer/source-pools.json: All six generation-case pools derived only from _context(case.messages.facts).factual_evidence; exact system instruction and fixed history, question, factual/prompt/message hashes and evidence pointers. No candidate style sources.
files.reviewer/README.md: Explain single-base offline scope, supplied-evidence support checks, genuine empty pools and ungraded human fields.
files.private/reference-answers.json: Original private reference answers and frozen hashes, kept outside source pools. Release separately only for an explicitly staged second review.
files.private/execution-diagnostics.json: Separate registered/planned/attempted/completed/failed/unattempted counts, failures/skipped IDs, raw provider versus normalized errors and identity outcomes.
files.private/input-manifest.json: Exact input/report/supervisor/condition inventory and genuine durable artifact identities and byte hashes.
files.manifest.json: Written last; payload hashes, counts, input hashes, share_only reviewer/, human_review ungraded and efficacy_claim false.

evidence_rules: messages = rag_case['messages']['facts']; facts = protocol._context(messages)['factual_evidence']; copy facts unchanged.
Preserve captured system and history constraints; no private reference answer is supplied evidence.
Do not use the earlier manually selected matched evidence, all-corpus passages, dropped retrieval hits, new retrieval or other-condition evidence.
Zero-evidence cases heldout-qa26-no-priors-2023-turn-00186 and ...-00253 must retain factual_evidence=[] and evidence_pointers=[].
Whole-corpus answerability is separate from the evidence actually supplied to a generated answer.
sample_gates: Normalize completion exactly as frozen generation.completed is True; exclude length/error/identity-unverified outputs from completed samples.
Underlying provider completed with no raw error; no normalized error or validation errors; expected response model and request digest; before/after identity verified.
Provider and normalized content match except explicitly allowed completion/error fields. Preserve whole unchanged answer and hash its exact UTF-8 bytes.
Retain every failed/unattempted case in private denominators; keep its source pool without inventing a reviewer sample.
Zero complete answers is an honest zero-sample packet, not grounds to retry or discard failures.

sharing.reference_access: private/reference-answers.json is separate and not shared in first support review
sharing.implementation_note: Existing blind_review.package_reviews requires three matched conditions and is not used unchanged for RAG.
